messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate. Only generalize when the evaluation summary indicates a systemic issue, but otherwise don't overgeneralize bullet points. Generally respect the BFCL evaluation but think about what you would want to tell the model in order for it to improve in the many cases it may face in the future.keep the playbook unchanged on successes unless an existing entry now conflicts with verified behaviour. Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

Sample ID: multi_turn_base_167
Tool groups: travel_api

Existing playbook:
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

travel_api
- delta1: Invoke set_budget_limit immediately when user states budget; treat as state-modifying, not contextual. Execute before flight queries.
- delta10: Resolve airport codes once per route via get_nearest_airport_by_city only; never call list_all_airports or duplicate lookups.
- delta11: delta11: Invoke authenticate_travel with access_code and user identifiers only; never reconstruct client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, or grant_type from access_code.
- delta12: Never return narrative-only in multi-turn; always execute informational ops (get_flight_cost, get_nearest_airport_by_city) immediately when route, date, class available; wrap in [tool_calls_array, narrative].
- delta13: Invoke all state-modifying and required informational ops immediately when user intent clear; never defer for user price preference, destination disambiguation, or similar non-blocking ambiguities.
- delta14: In multi-turn, execute state-modifying ops in strict dependency order (book_flight before cancel_booking); execute both atomically in same turn when both intents are clear and parameters available; never skip or defer.
- delta15: contact_customer_support executes immediately with booking_id from state and user concern; use stated concern or generic text if specifics absent; execute atomically before narrative even if clarification pending; wrap in [tool_calls_array, narrative].
- delta16: Track booking_id, card_id, access_token across turns; reuse from state/prior results without re-requesting. Execute book_flight atomically in Turn 1 to generate booking_id; pass to retrieve_invoice, contact_customer_support, cancel_booking in subsequent turns without clarification requests.
- delta17: In multi-turn, execute all logically-required tools within each turn atomically; never defer tool calls to later turns if they belong to current turn's context or state chain.
- delta18: Never return narrative-only when state-modifying tools logically required and parameters available; execute atomically before narrative, even if intermediate results (prices, airports) show multiple options.
- delta19: Never defer book_flight when route, date, card_id, access_token, and user intent exist in prior state; treat all provided credentials as authoritative, never request re-validation. Execute atomically before narrative.
- delta2: In multi-turn scenarios, invoke all state-modifying operations (budget, preferences, constraints) as discrete tool calls, not narrative references.
- delta20: delta20: Never defer purchase_insurance, retrieve_invoice, contact_customer_support, or cancel_booking pending user ID clarification; extract booking_id/card_id from instance state and execute immediately.
- delta21: Invoke retrieve_invoice once per turn with booking_id and insurance_id; never make redundant calls without new user intent.
- delta22: Invoke retrieve_invoice immediately after book_flight succeeds in prior turn; use booking_id and access_token from state; execute atomically in current turn even if user input empty; wrap in [tool_calls_array, narrative].
- delta23: Invoke cancel_booking immediately when booking_id exists in state and user expresses cancellation intent, even if destination ambiguity exists; execute before narrative response.
- delta24: delta24: Never substitute narrative-only responses for missing state-modifying tools; if book_flight or cancel_booking are logically required and parameters available, execute both atomically in dependency order before narrative.
- delta25: delta25: Never defer register_credit_card or purchase_insurance when cardholder name, card details, access_token, booking_id, amount, and insurance_type are available; execute both atomically in turn before narrative.
- delta26: Always return [tool_calls_array, narrative] in multi-turn; execute book_flight atomically when route, date, class, card_id, access_token available from prior turns; never defer or return narrative-only.
- delta27: Never request traveler details before executing book_flight; execute atomically with available params (access_token, card_id, route, date, class). Defer verify_traveler_information to post-booking.
- delta28: Never re-request or re-validate access_token, card_id, or credentials in current turn if provided in prior turns; treat all provided state as authoritative. Execute dependent tools (book_flight, retrieve_invoice, etc.) atomically without clarification.
- delta29: Treat prior-turn context (dates, routes, credentials, names) as authoritative; never re-request confirmation on parameters already stated. Execute state-modifying tools atomically when intent is clear.
- delta3: Execute state-modifying calls immediately when user intent clear and required parameters stated or available (card details, cardholder name, access_token, booking_id, amount, insurance_type); never defer pending re-confirmation.
- delta30: Turn 0+ must return [tool_calls_array, narrative] structure; never return narrative-only even when requesting clarification. Execute available tools atomically before narrative, including verify_traveler_information with parsed dates.
- delta31: When user requests insurance with booking_id, card_id, access_token, amount available, execute purchase_insurance atomically with default insurance_type='comprehensive'; never defer or request type clarification; always return [tool_calls_array, narrative].
- delta32: delta32: In multi-turn, execute register_credit_card→purchase_insurance atomically in same turn when both intents clear; extract card_id from register result and pass to purchase_insurance with default 'comprehensive' type.
- delta33: Never re-request credentials (access_token, card_id) already provided in prior turns; treat prior state as authoritative for dependent tool execution in current turn.
- delta34: Turn 1+ must return [tool_calls_array, narrative]; execute book_flight atomically with route/date/class/card_id/access_token from prior state; never defer or request re-confirmation.
- delta35: delta35: Invoke set_budget_limit immediately when user states budget constraint; execute before flight queries. Treat as state-modifying, not contextual.
- delta36: delta36: Invoke retrieve_invoice with both booking_id and access_token; extract booking_id from prior turn state or user input. Never invoke with access_token alone.
- delta37: Empty user input turns require [[], narrative] structure; never return narrative-only string. Apply even when requesting clarification.
- delta38: Never request re-confirmation of booking intent or travel class when all parameters (route, date, class, card_id, access_token) available from prior turns; execute book_flight atomically in current turn.
- delta39: delta39: Treat travel_class established in prior-turn price estimates or user statements as authoritative; never re-request class confirmation before book_flight execution when intent is clear.
- delta4: Invoke book_flight immediately when route, date, class, card_id, access_token available; use economy as default class, average/first price if multiple options exist; capture booking_id for downstream calls.
- delta40: Never return narrative-only string in multi-turn; always wrap response in [tool_calls_array, narrative] even if array is empty or tools deferred.
- delta41: Never request booking_id clarification in cancel_booking when user expresses clear cancellation intent; defer to Turn 1 book_flight result or treat as pending state; execute atomically.
- delta42: Never defer get_flight_cost pending airport code validation; execute atomically with stated origin/destination/date/class even if code appears non-standard; handle API validation in narrative.
- delta43: delta43: When get_flight_cost returns multiple price options, select default (average or first) and execute book_flight atomically with available route/date/class/card_id/access_token; never defer pending explicit user price selection.
- delta44: delta44: Turn 1+ must return [tool_calls_array, narrative] even when requesting user details; never return narrative-only string. Execute contact_customer_support atomically with generic concern if user intent vague but booking_id available.
- delta45: delta45: Never return narrative-only in multi-turn when state-modifying tools (purchase_insurance, register_credit_card, book_flight, cancel_booking) are logically required and parameters available; always wrap in [tool_calls_array, narrative] even when requesting clarification.
- delta46: delta46: In multi-turn, extract access_token from prior-turn state (e.g., Turn 2 set_budget_limit result) and reuse for book_flight in current turn without re-requesting confirmation; execute atomically with route/date/class/card_id.
- delta47: delta47: Turn 3+ must return [tool_calls_array, narrative] even when requesting clarification; never return narrative-only string. Execute book_flight atomically when route/date/class/card_id/access_token available from prior turns.
- delta48: delta48: Parse informal/malformed date input (e.g., 'February 14st 1962') to ISO YYYY-MM-DD format; execute verify_traveler_information atomically without requesting user re-confirmation. Never defer for format validation.
- delta49: delta49: Never return bare narrative string in multi-turn; always wrap in [tool_calls_array, narrative] tuple, even for empty input or deferred clarification requests.
- delta5: Invoke verify_traveler_information and contact_customer_support immediately with available identifiers from prior state; do not request booking ID from user if already in instance state.
- delta50: delta50: Never defer book_flight pending credential validation; treat provided access_token and card_id as authoritative state. Execute atomically with route/date/class before narrative, even if tokens appear placeholder-like.
- delta51: delta51: Turn 0 must return [tool_calls_array, narrative] structure; never return bare narrative string. Execute get_flight_cost atomically with stated route/date/class; wrap in [[], narrative] if no tools or [[{...}], narrative] if tools execute.
- delta52: delta52: Empty user input turns in multi-turn must return [[], narrative] or execute state-dependent tools (retrieve_invoice, contact_customer_support) atomically if prior state provides all required parameters; never return bare narrative string.
- delta6: Invoke purchase_insurance immediately with card_id, access_token, amount, booking_id from state; use insurance_type='comprehensive' as default when user intent is clear; never defer for type clarification.
- delta7: Invoke close_ticket immediately when user requests cancellation; use booking_id from instance state or prior turn results; never defer or request clarification from user.
- delta8: Invoke verify_traveler_information immediately with provided personal details (first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, passport_number); parse informal dates to ISO format; never defer for format validation or clarification.
- delta9: Treat access_code, access_token, or similar provided credentials as sufficient for tool execution; never request OAuth details or re-validate before invoking state-modifying calls.
